policy.historyRetention: No automatic deletion; at least 24 hours

liveTests.command: MODELLING_INTEGRATION_TEST=1 python -m unittest discover -s source-scripts/city/shared-modelling -p test_reservations.py -v
liveTests.qualification: Five live cases passed in the full run. A deliberately one-second lease test initially asserted a subsequent network round trip fit within one second; corrected to compare server timestamps and passed its targeted rerun. Four validation cases also passed.
liveTests.targetedRerun: MODELLING_INTEGRATION_TEST=1 python -m unittest discover -s source-scripts/city/shared-modelling -p test_reservations.py -k slow_resource -v

cli.command: python reservations.py run --lease-file TEMP_FIXTURE_RECEIPT -- python -c "raise SystemExit(0)"

coverage: canonical complete LandsD UIDs and no leading-zero aliases
expiry reclaim and stale token fencing
bounded renewal failure stops process group
dataSafety: Unique fixture resources only. Still-owned fixtures released; expired/superseded fixture history retained. No production writes, real model claims, publication or result changes.
limitations: Cooperative reservations do not atomically fence arbitrary files or R2 writes.
Manual AI work must heartbeat at checkpoints; only explicitly supervised concrete commands receive automatic heartbeats.
SIGKILL, machine failure or a child escaping its process group cannot guarantee local process cleanup.
Process-group supervision currently supports macOS and Linux.
